data.name: SignedOutText
data.value: You have been signed out. You can close this window.

data.name: SignedInText
data.value: You are signed in. Open the application you want to use at its own address.

data.name: ChangePasswordText
data.value: When you change it, your sessions in applications end and you sign in to them again with the new password. You stay signed in here.

data.name: PasswordRules
data.value: At least 12 characters, with an uppercase and a lowercase letter, a digit and a symbol.

data.name: PasswordChanged
data.value: Your password was changed. Your sessions in applications have ended: sign in to your applications again with the new password.

data.name: LockedOut
data.value: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in a few minutes.

data.name: PasswordRulesNotMet
data.value: The new password does not meet the rules below.

data.name: VerificationCodeText
data.value: Enter the code your authenticator app shows for Kale, or one of your recovery codes.

data.name: TwoFactorRequired
data.value: Two-step sign-in is required here. Turn it on to continue.

data.name: TwoFactorSetupText
data.value: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app on your phone (for example FreeOTP, Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator). From then on, signing in asks for the code the app shows, after your password.

data.name: TwoFactorKeyText
data.value: If you can't scan it, type this key into the app:

data.name: OpenInAuthenticatorApp
data.value: Open in the authenticator app on this device

data.name: TwoFactorConfirmText
data.value: Then enter the code the app shows to turn it on.

data.name: RecoveryCodesText
data.value: Write down these recovery codes and keep them somewhere safe. If you lose your phone, each of them signs you in once instead of a code from the app. They are shown only now.

data.name: TurnOffText
data.value: To turn it off, enter a code from the app or a recovery code. Signing in then asks only for your password.

data.name: TwoFactorIsOff
data.value: Two-step sign-in is off. Turn it on, and signing in asks for a code from an authenticator app on your phone after your password.
